name: OpenVE-Bench
description: OpenVE-Bench evaluates visual entailment / visual-language reasoning: given an image and a textual hypothesis, models must decide whether the image entails, contradicts, or is neutral with respect to the hypothesis. It measures multimodal reasoning and robustness across diverse image–text pairs and is intended to benchmark vision-language models on open visual entailment scenarios.
reputation: A focused benchmark used in vision–language research for visual entailment; less ubiquitous than VQA but useful for entailment-specific evaluation.
